info.title: MARS Control Center API
info.description: Observation and human-decision interface over the MARS engine. Read endpoints return snapshots built from the run's persisted artifacts; the event stream replays and streams execution events; commands call the engine's own analyze / decide / resume. JSON is snake_case; absent fields have no value. Errors share one shape: {code, message, run_id, correlation_id, details}. Commands accept an Idempotency-Key header. See docs/control-center-api.md.

post.summary: Start a run (phases 0-4, stopping at Gate A). OPERATOR.
Advance the run to its next gate or its verdict (the CLI's resume). OPERATOR.
Human Gate B: approve, reject or defer one exact proposal (bound to its hash). APPROVER.
Human Gate A2: PROCEED, SKIP or STOP, then advance. APPROVER.
Approve, reject or defer the frozen migration plan, then advance. APPROVER.
Human Gate A: record the execution strategy, then advance. APPROVER.
